rationale: Max scenario net load (load-renewable) is t1=72, t2=77, t3=69; adding reserve 8 gives required thermal generation 80, 85, 77. Cheapest generator g1 is dispatched to its pmax of 70 in all periods (required exceeds or equals 70 in each), with g2 covering the remainder above its pmin of 5. Margins equal the 8 MW reserve in every period.
